name: New Beginning
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the initiator of all new beginnings, as demonstrated in the creation of the heavens and the earth in Genesis 1:1. The Lord calls His people to obedience and promises exaltation when they follow His commands, signaling a fresh start rooted in faithfulness (Deuteronomy 28:1). Isaiah 43 encourages believers to forget past failures and anticipate God’s new work, which will bring provision and guidance even in desolate circumstances. This hope is sustained by God's unfailing mercy and compassion, assuring that His people are preserved and renewed (Lamentations 3:22).
